beta_rule: beta = reduced_beta / (E1-E0) from converged quantum diagonalization at the same shape

acceptance.sustained_rule: Candidate and all sampled finer bead counts pass, with at least one strictly finer confirmation.
acceptance.tie_or_boundary_policy: Report classification unresolved if numerical uncertainty straddles an accuracy threshold that would affect the selected configuration.

mechanism_control.variant: free-bridge tail first cumulant at fixed P,K,L

md.force_candidates_rule: Primitive and minimum-site BF at the primary endpoint gate. Also measure fixed K1 L2 where it selects a different configuration at reduced beta 8 if beads <=64. At s=0 and 1 at reduced beta 8 include the next finer accepted BF bead count in the same selected scheme.
md.agreement_rule: Each mean within 3.5 independent-chain SE plus 0.2% from the independent same-action mean. A dt/2 paired configuration preserves artificial sampling duration and has the analogous combined-SE bound.

timings.definition: Same observables and acquisition cadence. Estimate force-dominated time via number of evaluated force sites and ToyModel wall time separately using autocorrelation and variance.
timings.cases_rule: All tested endpoint cases at reduced beta 8; for reduced beta 0.5 and 16 include s=0 and s=1.
